name: io.github.gregcastro23/planetary-agents-mcp
description: Eight Planetary Agents tools + 4 resources + 2 RFC 6570 templates + 3 prompts: 72 historical mentor vessels, Natal-Sky Bi-Wheel resonance, Pentacle Vessel Ratings (25-99 OVR, 7 Seals, 11-zone ECR, 4D ESMS diamond), and multi-agent council deliberation.

environmentVariables.name: ALCHM_MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional agents.alchm.kitchen / alchm.kitchen API key (sk_alchm_...). 5 read-only tools and all resources/prompts work with zero authentication on the Free tier; metered council and duel tools require a Bearer key.
